title: Maintained evidence index, generation 1
description: The explicit membership authority for maintained evidence under root evidence/. SPEC-0017 forbids discovering maintained authorities by scanning the filesystem, so an authority that is not listed here is not part of the repository no matter where its bytes sit. The index names authorities; it never states what they contain, whether they hold, or what any of them is worth.

indexGeneration.description: Which generation of the index this is. A membership change is a new generation and never an edit in place.

authorityClass.description: What kind of authority the listed bytes are. Exactly the two classes that exist at this gate. A baseline record and an active baseline role are absent deliberately: Tier 0 cannot create, promote, activate, or trust a baseline, so an entry naming one is refused here rather than by convention, and the generation that admits one is the generation that adds the class.

path.description: A repository-relative path beneath evidence/. Anchored to that root, closed to relative and parent segments, and closed to anything but JSON, so the index cannot reach outside maintained evidence.
